definitions.gloss: to rise, to go up, to ascend
definitions.explanation: For smoke, steam, mist, or similar things to rise upward. Often used for visual phenomena that drift or billow upward.

examples.japanese: {煙|けむり}が{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る。
{温泉|おんせん}から{湯気|ゆげ}が{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}っていた。
examples.english: Steam was rising from the hot spring.

examples.japanese: {火山|かざん}の{火口|かこう}から{白|しろ}い{煙|けむり}が{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}っているのが{見|み}えた。
examples.english: I could see white smoke rising from the volcano's crater.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). The subject (smoke, steam, etc.) rises on its own.

CONJUGATION (godan, る-row):
- Negative: {立|た}ち{上|のぼ}らない
- Te-form: {立|た}ち{上|のぼ}って
- Past: {立|た}ち{上|のぼ}った

ASPECT:
{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}っている indicates smoke or steam is currently rising (ongoing action).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煙|けむり}が{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る: smoke rises
- {湯気|ゆげ}が{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る: steam rises
- {霧|きり}が{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る: mist rises

NOTE: Not to be confused with {立|た}ち{上|あ}がる (to stand up, to start up), which has a different reading and meaning.
